architectural-safety-films.body: High-quality films for building glass and industrial applications, providing solar control and safety enhancement.

headlight-specialty-films.title: Headlight Films
headlight-specialty-films.intro: 结合灯罩材质、效果与施工方式选型。
headlight-specialty-films.body: Protective and decorative films specifically designed for automotive lighting and specialty accents.

nano-ceramic-window-tint.title: Automotive Window Film
nano-ceramic-window-tint.intro: 按色深、具体型号和测试条件比较窗膜。
nano-ceramic-window-tint.body:
Choose automotive window tint for car glass by visible light transmission (VLT), shade and film thickness. The Constant Color TiN window film series lists a 1.52 m × 30 m roll and model-specific VLT values. Check the selected model against the intended window and local tint rules.

Compare Constant Color window film. Send your target VLT, model, roll quantity and destination to request a quote. Request a wholesale quote.

For exterior glass protection, see Glass Shield KPU windshield film and TPU sunroof film.

pet-color-change-wrap.title: Pet Color Change Wrap
pet-color-change-wrap.intro: 按系列和色号查看原厂色、水晶、液态金属改色膜的实物图和整卷规格。
pet-color-change-wrap.body:
Choose a color change car wrap when the job calls for a new body colour. In the PET Crystal series, PVC is the installed face film and PET is the removable release liner. Crystal and Liquid Metal are available in 1.52 m × 16 m rolls. Select by colour code and review a physical swatch before ordering.

View PET Crystal color change wrap. For samples or wholesale pricing, provide the colour code, roll quantity and destination. Request a wholesale quote.

phosphorescent-film.title: Phosphorescent film
phosphorescent-film.intro: 老站介绍了采用蓄光材料的薄膜类别，可按发光颜色、余辉时间与施工基面咨询样品。
phosphorescent-film.body: YUNNIAN's phosphorescent film uses rare earth extracts as its phosphorescent material and is non-toxic, non-radioactive, and chemically stable.

professional-tools.title: Professional tools
professional-tools.intro: 老站收录施工、检测和演示工具类别，具体品项可按作业需求询价。
professional-tools.body: including, but not limited to, tools for construction, testing, and demonstration

reflective-film.title: Reflective film
reflective-film.intro: 目录提及 H5500 钻石级反光膜、双色警示膜、反光喷绘布和晶格反光贴，可按场景咨询对应型号。
reflective-film.body:
H5500 Diamond Grade: Top-of-the-line series featuring an acrylic surface layer, available in highly visible colors such as white, fluorescent yellow-green, and fluorescent orange, designed for use on high-grade highway signage.
Two-Tone Warning Film: Red-and-white or yellow-and-black diagonal/straight-striped reflective film, specifically designed for collision warning at toll booths, tunnel pillars, and railroad crossing posts.
Reflective Flex Banner: Fabric-based material suitable for large-scale outdoor advertising prints.
Crystal Grid Reflective Tape: PVC material compatible with UV printing, commonly used for vehicle reflective decals and temporary construction signs.

tpu-color-ppf-color-change-wrap.title: TPU Color PPF
tpu-color-ppf-color-change-wrap.intro: 从原厂色、液态金属、珠光、水晶和纹理中选择现成颜色。
tpu-color-ppf-color-change-wrap.body:
Colored paint protection film combines a new body colour with a TPU paint-protection layer. Compare the Classic OEM, Liquid Metal and Glossy Crystal series by finish. Classic OEM is supplied in 1.52 m × 15 m rolls at 7.5 mil.

See Classic OEM colored PPF. Include the series, shade or colour code and roll quantity when requesting samples or wholesale pricing. Request a wholesale quote.

tpu-paint-protection-film-ppf-2.title: TPU Paint Protection Film
tpu-paint-protection-film-ppf-2.intro: 按基材、卷材规格与应用区分透明车衣、APC 车衣和两轮车用膜。
tpu-paint-protection-film-ppf-2.body:
Clear TPU paint protection film (PPF) lets the original paint colour show through. For full-vehicle installations, our embedded-coating series comes in 1.52 m × 15 m rolls with a choice of 7.5 or 8.5 mil. The Lubrizol SM301 series offers 6.5, 7.5, 8.5 and 9.5 mil options.

Compare the clear TPU roll options. For a wholesale quote, send the series, thickness, roll quantity and delivery country. Request a wholesale quote.

Other protective films: Space Armor APC paint protection film · motorcycle and e-bike protective rolls.
